CustomField.formula:
IF( Type_of_User__c = 'ICT User', Gross_Salary__c - Super_Annuation1__c - Management_Fee1__c - Pre_tax_values__c - IF( TEXT(Voluntary_Contribution__c) = 'Fixed', Voluntary_Contribution_Fixed__c, Gross_Salary__c * Voluntary_Contribution_Percent__c ),
IF( AND( Type_of_User__c = 'NDIS User', TEXT(Superannuation_Inc_or_exc__c) = 'Include Superannuation' ), Gross_Salary__c - Super_Annuation1__c - Management_Fee1__c - Pre_tax_values__c - IF( TEXT(Voluntary_Contribution__c) = 'Fixed', Voluntary_Contribution_Fixed__c, Gross_Salary__c * Voluntary_Contribution_Percent__c ), Gross_Salary__c - Management_Fee1__c - Pre_tax_values__c - IF( TEXT(Voluntary_Contribution__c) = 'Fixed', Voluntary_Contribution_Fixed__c, Gross_Salary__c * Voluntary_Contribution_Percent__c ) ) )
